description: June 29 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 29 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: The June 29 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Master number 11 meets the Moon's own decan on the 29th of June, and the result is traditionally one of the most intuitive birthdays in the calendar. Seven degrees into Cancer, feelings register early and deeply. Interpretive astrology describes a sensitive visionary who picks up on atmospheres, and who does best with creative outlets that turn those impressions into something shareable.

Astronomically, June 29 puts the Sun near 7° Cancer in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Moon. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for June 29
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a June 29 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous June 29 birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 29 is the 180th day of the year (181st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Leo, is usually complete within 24 days, by July 23.

By June 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a June 29 birthday are Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (1900), Giacomo Leopardi (1798) and Giorgio Napolitano (1925).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 29?
faq.answer: June 29 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 29 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 29?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 29, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 29?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on June 29 include Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (1900), Giacomo Leopardi (1798) and Giorgio Napolitano (1925). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
